title: Contextuality as a Left Adjoint: A Categorical Generation of Orthomodular Structure
summary: Contextuality is widely regarded as a hallmark of quantum information, yet its structural origin is often obscured by probabilistic or operational formulations. In this work, we show that non-distributive orthomodular structure need not be postulated, but arises canonically as a left adjoint from classical Boolean contexts. We introduce a gluing functor that takes pairs of Boolean algebras and identifies only their minimal and maximal elements via a categorical pushout.
